metadata.scalar_domain: finite observed graph values plus booleans

control.description: Entity type and identity stubs plus control attributes. No relationship edges or graph profile fields.

graph.description: Entity types, business IDs, profile attributes and all stored directed edges; no control attributes.

schema.identity_semantics: Canonical node identity joins across stores; id is a raw string business ID, not canonical identity.

scalar_semantics.createTime: calendar string YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm; order with timestamp_ms
scalar_semantics.missing_fields: Missing nullable properties return null; no implicit lookup in another source.
scalar_semantics.parallel_edges: Each edge has a separate canonical identity, even for equal endpoints and values.
